note: Example data: an invented online booking software company answering an RFP from an invented physiotherapy group, not real businesses. Every number in expected_output.json follows from this input.
request: Hey Claude, I just added the "sales-proposal-writer" skill. Here's an RFP from Harbor Physio Group for online booking across 14 clinics, our answer library and price list. Tell me if we should bid, and if yes, draft the answers.

seller.name: Example Booking Software
seller.product: online booking, reminders and payments for salons, clinics, studios and personal trainers

rfp.title: RFP 2026-07: Patient online booking and reminder system

sections.1.2: Key dates: questions by 2026-11-06, responses due 2026-11-20 17:00 Eastern, award decision by 2026-12-15, contract start 2027-01-04.
sections.1.3: Submit one PDF through the Harbor procurement portal by 2026-11-20 17:00 Eastern.
sections.1.4: Send questions by email to the procurement office by 2026-11-06. Answers are shared with all bidders.
sections.1.5: The response must not exceed 25 pages, excluding Form B.
sections.1.6: Each answer in sections 3 and 4 must not exceed 150 words.
sections.1.7: Pricing must be given on Form B, signed by an officer of the bidder.
sections.1.8: Bidders may submit one alternate pricing proposal in addition to the base price.
sections.2.1: Harbor Physio Group runs 14 outpatient physiotherapy clinics with about 90 clinicians.
sections.2.2: We want to "reduce missed appointments", "let patients book outside office hours" and "give the central team one view of every clinic's schedule".
sections.2.3: The budget for the first three years is up to $75,000 including all one-time costs.

goals.goal: let patients book outside office hours
give the central team one view of every clinic's schedule

requirements.text: Patients must be able to book online 24/7 from web and mobile, without installing an app.
The system shall send automated SMS and email reminders, with timing configurable per clinic.
Central administration of all 14 clinics, each with its own calendars, staff and hours, is required.
Staff must sign in through single sign-on with Microsoft Entra ID over SAML 2.0.
Appointments must sync with our electronic health record, ChartBase EHR.
The system shall take deposits and card payments at the time of booking.
The vendor must sign a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement.
The vendor shall commit to 99.9% monthly uptime, with service credits when it is missed.
All 14 clinics must be live by 2027-03-01.
The vendor shall provide an export of all appointment records in CSV on request.
A waitlist should automatically offer cancelled slots to waiting patients.
Clinicians should have two-way sync with Google and Outlook calendars.
A report of no-show rate by clinic is preferred.
Patients should complete digital intake forms before their first visit.
The booking page should meet WCAG 2.1 AA.
Provide an itemised three-year total cost for 14 clinics, separating one-time and recurring costs, on Form B.
Provide three references from healthcare customers with several locations.

offer.O1: Online booking page and a booking button for your website; works in any browser on phone or desktop, no app needed.
offer.O2: Automatic SMS and email reminders on a schedule each location sets; patients reply to confirm or cancel.
offer.O3: Business plan: one admin account for every location, each with its own calendars, staff, hours and services; up to 20 staff per location.
offer.O4: Deposits and card payments taken when the patient books.
offer.O5: Two-way sync with Google Calendar and Outlook calendars for each staff member.
offer.O6: Location reports with bookings, cancellations and no-shows by day; every report exports to CSV.
offer.O7: SAML 2.0 single sign-on add-on for Microsoft Entra ID, Okta and Google Workspace.
offer.O8: REST API and webhooks for new, changed and cancelled appointments; no prebuilt connectors to health record systems.
offer.O9: Standard rollout: 2 weeks of setup (sign-on, integrations, data import), then clinics go live in waves of up to 4 a week.
offer.O10: Waitlist auto-fill is on the roadmap for Q2 2027 and is not committed.

rows.question: Can patients book online without an app?
rows.answer: Patients book from a booking page or a button on your website, on any device, at any hour. No app download is needed.

rows.question: How do reminders work?
rows.answer: Automatic SMS and email reminders go out on a schedule each location sets, for example 48 hours and 2 hours before. Patients confirm or cancel by replying.

rows.question: Do you support several locations?
rows.answer: On the Business plan, one admin account manages every location, each with its own calendars, staff, hours and services.

rows.question: Will you sign a BAA?
rows.answer: We sign a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement with Business plan customers.

rows.question: Do you support single sign-on?
rows.answer: SAML 2.0 single sign-on works with Microsoft Entra ID, Okta and Google Workspace as a paid add-on.

rows.question: Do you integrate with EHR systems?
rows.answer: A REST API and webhooks send new, changed and cancelled appointments to other systems in real time. We have no prebuilt EHR connectors.

rows.question: How is data secured?
rows.answer: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest and hosted in US data centres.

rows.question: What reporting is included?
rows.answer: Location reports show bookings, cancellations and no-shows by day, and any report exports to CSV.

rows.question: Can we export our data?
rows.answer: Admins can export all appointment records to CSV at any time, and we provide a full export within 5 business days on request.

rows.question: Is the booking page accessible?
rows.answer: Our booking page was tested against WCAG 2.1 AA.
